mapper.select: SELECT ID AS USER_ID, NAME AS USER_NM, LEVEL_NM AS POSITION_NM, EMP_NO AS EMP_NO, DEPT_ID AS DEPT_ID, DEPT_NM AS DEPT_NM FROM ( SELECT C.ID, C.NAME, L.LEVEL_NM, C.EMP_NO, D.DEPT_ID, D.DEPT_NM FROM TB_CM06M01 C LEFT JOIN TB_CM04M01 D ON C.DEPT_ID = D.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_CM07M01 L ON C.LEVEL_CD = L.LEVEL_CD WHERE C.DEPT_ID = 'GUN6010' AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY C.NAME ASC ) WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT RSV_NO AS RSV_NO, CO_CD AS CO_CD, USER_ID AS USER_ID, (SELECT NAME FROM TB_CM06M01 WHERE ID = TB_PM60M01.USER_ID) AS USER_NM, TRIP_DIV AS TRIP_DIV, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(TRIP_DIV) AS TRIP_DIV_NM, TRIP_TYPE_CDS AS TRIP_TYPE_CDS, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(TRIP_TYPE_CDS) AS TRIP_TYPE_CDS_NM, TRIP_COND_CD AS TRIP_COND_CD, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(TRIP_COND_CD) AS TRIP_COND_CD_NM, RSV_STS_CD AS RSV_STS_CD, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(RSV_STS_CD) AS RSV_STS_CD_NM, TRIP_PLACE AS TRIP_PLACE, TRIP_ST_DTM AS TRIP_ST_DTM, TRIP_ED_DTM AS TRIP_ED_DTM, NIGHT_CNT AS NIGHT_CNT, DAY_CNT AS DAY_CNT, ETC AS ETC, TRIP_REQ_NO AS TRIP_REQ_NO, CREAT_ID AS CREAT_ID, CREAT_DTTM AS CREAT_DTTM, UDT_ID AS UDT_ID, UDT_DTTM AS UDT_DTTM FROM TB_PM60M01 WHERE RSV_NO = #{rsvNo}
mapper.insert:
SELECT 'RV' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || LPAD(MOD(TB_PM60M01_SQ01.NEXTVAL, 10000), 4, '0') FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_PM60M01 ( RSV_NO, CO_CD, USER_ID, TRIP_DIV, TRIP_TYPE_CDS, TRIP_COND_CD, RSV_STS_CD, TRIP_PLACE, TRIP_ST_DTM, TRIP_ED_DTM, NIGHT_CNT, DAY_CNT, ETC, TRIP_REQ_NO, CREAT_ID, CREAT_PGM, CREAT_DTTM ) VALUES ( #{rsvNo}, #{coCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tripDiv, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tripTypeCds, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tripCondCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{rsvStsCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tripPlace, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tripStDtm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tripEdDtm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{nightCnt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{dayCnt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{etc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tripReqNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{creatId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'PM6001P01', SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PM60M01 SET TRIP_DIV = #{tripDiv, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRIP_TYPE_CDS = #{tripTypeCds, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRIP_COND_CD = #{tripCondCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, RSV_STS_CD = #{rsvStsCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRIP_PLACE = #{tripPlace, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRIP_ST_DTM = #{tripStDtm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRIP_ED_DTM = #{tripEdDtm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NIGHT_CNT = #{nightCnt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, DAY_CNT = #{dayCnt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, ETC = #{etc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRIP_REQ_NO = #{tripReqNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UDT_ID = #{creatId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UDT_PGM = 'PM6001P01', UDT_DTTM = SYSDATE WHERE RSV_NO = #{rsvNo}
mapper.insert:
SELECT 'RV2' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || LPAD(MOD(TB_PM60M02_SQ01.NEXTVAL, 10000), 4, '0') FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_PM60M02 ( RSV_NO, CO_CD, VNDR_NM, WORK_DT, WORK_HOUR, ETC, CREAT_ID, CREAT_PGM, CREAT_DTTM ) VALUES ( #{rsvNo}, #{coCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{vndrNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workHour, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{etc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{creatId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'PM6001P01', SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PM60M02 SET VNDR_NM = #{vndrNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, WORK_DT = #{workDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, WORK_HOUR = #{workHour, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, ETC = #{etc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UDT_ID = #{creatId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UDT_PGM = 'PM6001P01', UDT_DTTM = SYSDATE WHERE RSV_NO = #{rsvNo}
mapper.select: WITH CALENDAR_TBL AS ( SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{monthStDt},'YYYYMMDD') + LEVEL - 1, 'YYYYMMDD') AS WORK_DT FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= (TO_DATE(#{monthEdDt},'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(#{monthStDt},'YYYYMMDD') + 1) ), EFFECTIVE_ACTUAL AS ( SELECT D.USER_ID AS USER_ID, M.TRIP_REQ_NO AS TRIP_REQ_NO, M.TRIP_TYPE_CDS AS TRIP_TYPE_CDS, NVL(( SELECT D2.TRIP_ST_DTM FROM TB_PM52D02 D2 INNER JOIN TB_PM52M01 R ON R.TRIP_RPT_NO = D2.TRIP_RPT_NO WHERE R.TRIP_REQ_NO = M.TRIP_REQ_NO AND D2.USER_ID = D.USER_ID AND ROWNUM = 1 ), D.TRIP_ST_DTM) AS EFF_ST_DTM, NVL(( SELECT D2.TRIP_ED_DTM FROM TB_PM52D02 D2 INNER JOIN TB_PM52M01 R ON R.TRIP_RPT_NO = D2.TRIP_RPT_NO WHERE R.TRIP_REQ_NO = M.TRIP_REQ_NO AND D2.USER_ID = D.USER_ID AND ROWNUM = 1 ), D.TRIP_ED_DTM) AS EFF_ED_DTM FROM TB_PM51D01 D INNER JOIN TB_PM51M01 M ON M.TRIP_REQ_NO = D.TRIP_REQ_NO WHERE D.USER_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM TB_CM06M01 WHERE DEPT_ID = 'GUN6010' AND USE_YN = 'Y') ) SELECT C.WORK_DT AS WORK_DT, SUBSTR(C.WORK_DT, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(C.WORK_DT, 5, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(C.WORK_DT, 7, 2) AS WORK_DT_DISP, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CM06M01 WHERE DEPT_ID='GUN6010' AND USE_YN='Y') AS TOTAL_CNT, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT USER_ID) FROM TB_PM60M01 WHERE CO_CD = 'GUN' AND SUBSTR(TRIP_ST_DTM, 1, 8) <= C.WORK_DT AND SUBSTR(TRIP_ED_DTM, 1, 8) >= C.WORK_DT ), 0) AS PLAN_CNT, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CM06M01 WHERE DEPT_ID='GUN6010' AND USE_YN='Y' ), 0) - COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT U.USER_ID) FROM ( SELECT USER_ID FROM TB_PM60M01 WHERE CO_CD = 'GUN' AND SUBSTR(TRIP_ST_DTM, 1, 8) <= C.WORK_DT AND SUBSTR(TRIP_ED_DTM, 1, 8) >= C.WORK_DT UNION SELECT WORK_RPT_ID AS USER_ID FROM TB_PM01M01 WHERE WORK_RPT_S LIKE '%9901' AND TO_CHAR(WORK_RPT_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') = C.WORK_DT ) U WHERE U.USER_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM TB_CM06M01 WHERE DEPT_ID='GUN6010' AND USE_YN='Y') ), 0) AS AVAIL_CNT, ( COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT USER_ID) FROM EFFECTIVE_ACTUAL WHERE SUBSTR(EFF_ST_DTM, 1, 8) <= C.WORK_DT AND SUBSTR(EFF_ED_DTM, 1, 8) >= C.WORK_DT AND TRIP_TYPE_CDS = 'PM51TYPE30' ), 0) + COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT USER_ID) FROM EFFECTIVE_ACTUAL WHERE SUBSTR(EFF_ST_DTM, 1, 8) <= C.WORK_DT AND SUBSTR(EFF_ED_DTM, 1, 8) >= C.WORK_DT AND TRIP_TYPE_CDS = 'PM51TYPE60' ), 0) + COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT USER_ID) FROM EFFECTIVE_ACTUAL WHERE SUBSTR(EFF_ST_DTM, 1, 8) <= C.WORK_DT AND SUBSTR(EFF_ED_DTM, 1, 8) >= C.WORK_DT AND TRIP_TYPE_CDS = 'PM51TYPE40' ), 0) + COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT USER_ID) FROM EFFECTIVE_ACTUAL WHERE SUBSTR(EFF_ST_DTM, 1, 8) <= C.WORK_DT AND SUBSTR(EFF_ED_DTM, 1, 8) >= C.WORK_DT AND (TRIP_TYPE_CDS NOT IN ('PM51TYPE30', 'PM51TYPE60', 'PM51TYPE40') OR TRIP_TYPE_CDS IS NULL) ), 0) ) AS ACTUAL_CNT, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT USER_ID) FROM EFFECTIVE_ACTUAL WHERE SUBSTR(EFF_ST_DTM, 1, 8) <= C.WORK_DT AND SUBSTR(EFF_ED_DTM, 1, 8) >= C.WORK_DT AND TRIP_TYPE_CDS = 'PM51TYPE30' ), 0) AS INSTALL_CNT, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT USER_ID) FROM EFFECTIVE_ACTUAL WHERE SUBSTR(EFF_ST_DTM, 1, 8) <= C.WORK_DT AND SUBSTR(EFF_ED_DTM, 1, 8) >= C.WORK_DT AND TRIP_TYPE_CDS = 'PM51TYPE60' ), 0) AS PAID_CNT, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT USER_ID) FROM EFFECTIVE_ACTUAL WHERE SUBSTR(EFF_ST_DTM, 1, 8) <= C.WORK_DT AND SUBSTR(EFF_ED_DTM, 1, 8) >= C.WORK_DT AND TRIP_TYPE_CDS = 'PM51TYPE40' ), 0) AS FREE_CNT, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT USER_ID) FROM EFFECTIVE_ACTUAL WHERE SUBSTR(EFF_ST_DTM, 1, 8) <= C.WORK_DT AND SUBSTR(EFF_ED_DTM, 1, 8) >= C.WORK_DT AND (TRIP_TYPE_CDS NOT IN ('PM51TYPE30', 'PM51TYPE60', 'PM51TYPE40') OR TRIP_TYPE_CDS IS NULL) ), 0) AS ETC_CNT FROM CALENDAR_TBL C ORDER BY C.WORK_DT ASC
